'// shared: flag[0] = flag[1] = false, turn = 0
loop forever:
  idle: flag[me] = true
  turn: turn = other
  wait: wait until flag[other] == false
             or turn == me
  crit: critical section
        flag[me] = false'

loop forever:
  idle: flag[me] = true
  turn: turn = other
  wait: wait until flag[other] == false

  crit: // 临界区
        flag[me] = false'
